intro.line: Zendikar. Act 17 ended with the Eldrazi titans set free. Ulamog and Kozilek have spent the years since eating the world.
The continent of Bala Ged was ravaged by massive Eldrazi of Ulamog's lineage, its lush jungles and cascading rivers reduced to dust.
"Sea Gate has fallen. Survivors are on the move. Will send another griffin when we find refuge. Stay hidden. Stay safe."
Four planeswalkers are coming, each from a different world, each for a different reason.

finale.line: Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek to reality, but it was Nissa who could trace it on her world.
As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.
For justice and peace, I will keep watch.
For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.
For the life of every plane, I will keep watch.
If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.
Two titans are ash. The third, Emrakul, is not on Zendikar at all. Nobody knows where she went.

villainFinale.line: The leylines slip. The titans walk on.
Dust and memory are all that remain in Ulamog's wake.
No matter how big your champion, theirs is bigger. No matter how great your numbers, theirs are greater. No matter how voracious your appetite, they are hungrier. That is why the Eldrazi will win.

portrait.card: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound

battles.title: The Fall of Sea Gate
battles.blurb: You arrive on the coast of Tazeem as Sea Gate, the great lighthouse city, falls to Ulamog's brood. Gideon Jura is leading the survivors out with a line of kor and human Allies.

scene.line: Though Gideon arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre, he still had enough time to lead its survivors to relative safety.
For the lands you have lost and the beauty that remains, for freedom and the future, we must hold nothing back!
Ingest: when an ingest creature deals combat damage to you, you exile the top card of your library. Processors then use those exiled cards. Block the small ones.

villainScene.line: Every Eldrazi in Ulamog's lineage is an extension of the titan's will.
Ulamog's progeny swarm the land, draining Zendikar's mana to feed the titan's insatiable hunger.

after.line: We need more than soldiers. We need people who can leave this world and choose to stay.

battles.title: The Land Fights Back
battles.blurb: Nissa Revane is an elf animist who can wake the land itself. Zendikar is in pain, and she is the only one who can hear it.

cards.name: Nissa, Vastwood Seer // Nissa, Sage Animist

scene.line: I was wrong. Zendikar isn't after me. It isn't after any of us. It's not evil or vengeful. It's magnificent . . . but it's in pain.
The land will not wait for the enemy to arrive.
Awaken: cast the spell for its awaken cost and one of your lands also becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature with that many +1/+1 counters. It is still a land.

villainScene.line: Ulamog's processors trail behind him, converting ruined matter into furious energy.
In the dark places of our world, something horrible is growing. I fear our foes may be more numerous than we had imagined.

after.line: This world tires of its long occupation.

battles.title: The Prodigy
battles.blurb: Jace's origin: years ago on Vryn, a young mind mage worked for a sphinx called Alhammarret, who used him to spy on everyone. Jace has finally noticed.

cards.name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound

scene.line: He taught me everything. I am starting to wonder what else he took.
Spell mastery: some spells get a bonus if there are two or more instants or sorceries in your graveyard. Use cheap spells early, then cash in.

villainScene.line: As long as each side thinks it can win, the balance holds, and the mage-rings stand.

after.line: Jace remembers. Years later, a stranger called Gideon finds him on Ravnica and asks for his help on Zendikar.

battles.title: Reignited
battles.blurb: Chandra Nalaar is a pyromancer who hates being told to stay. On Zendikar she finds Ob Nixilis, a demon who wants revenge on the world that took his spark long ago.

cards.name: Chandra, Fire of Kaladesh // Chandra, Roaring Flame

scene.line: I hope to meet Jaya Ballard someday. I think we'd get along.
Devoid: these cards have colour in their cost but no colour. Anything that cares about colour, like protection from black, does not see them.

villainScene.line: I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time.
Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise.
I have suffered a thousand lifetimes of agony on this wretched world. I've far less time to share with you, but I assure you, no less pain.

after.line: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality—except Chandra Nalaar.

battles.title: The Depths
battles.blurb: Kiora, who once tried to out-sea a sea god on Theros (Act 21), has come home to Zendikar with monsters of her own. Kozilek's brood is in the water too.

scene.line: The seas are no less imperiled than the dry lands. This fight is mine as much as it is yours.
Nissa is not the only one with a deep connection to Zendikar's primal elements.
Surge: if you or a teammate cast another spell this turn, surge cards cost less. They chain cheap spells together.

villainScene.line: Kozilek's brood infiltrates and deceives. The spawn of Ulamog mindlessly consume.
When Kozilek emerged at Sea Gate, his brood lineage swarmed to the surface.

after.line: Kozilek is here. At Sea Gate. Tell your Gideon he will need more than a speech.

battles.title: The Ceaseless Hunger
battles.blurb: The Archive remembers late 2015: Eldrazi Ramp, which made enough mana to cast Ulamog, against the Ally decks that tried to win first.

scene.line: The last hedron slotted into place, locking Ulamog in an infinite loop of binding energy.
Survive to ten mana. Then everything they built goes away.

villainScene.line: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

after.line: Recorded: Battle for Zendikar Standard, late 2015.

battles.title: Thopters and Vampires
battles.blurb: The Archive remembers 2015: blue-red thopter decks built around Pia and Kiran Nalaar and Thopter Spy Network, against Drana's Kalastria vampires.

cards.name: Jace, Vryn's Prodigy // Jace, Telepath Unbound

scene.line: "The rare and beautiful butterflies inspire the design of our thopters. The larvae, however, are a different story entirely."
Fliers in the air, sacrifice fodder on the ground. Keep making thopters.

villainScene.line: Despite their bravado, mortals are fragile. If Zendikar is to endure, its lords must save it.
Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again.

after.line: Recorded: Magic Origins and Battle for Zendikar Standard, 2015.

battles.title: Ulamog and Kozilek
battles.blurb: At the ruins of Sea Gate, the four planeswalkers swear their oath. Then they go to work: Jace finds the pattern, Nissa binds the titans to the land, Gideon holds the brood back, and Chandra brings the fire.

scene.line: I've heard it said that a Planeswalker is someone who can always run from danger. But Gideon's right: we're also the ones who can choose to stay.
Our time grows short. If we wish to vanquish the Eldrazi, we must unlock the hedrons' secrets.
While we delay, they're on the move. They will not wait as we bicker. We are losing this war by moments as our goal slips beyond our reach.
Hold them in place. I will tie them to the world. Chandra does the rest.

villainScene.line: A void as cryptic as reality itself.
No matter how big your champion, theirs is bigger. No matter how great your numbers, theirs are greater. No matter how voracious your appetite, they are hungrier. That is why the Eldrazi will win.

hero.half: Answer the titan when it lands.

half.line: They are pinned! Get clear, I am lighting them up!

battles.title: Eldrazi Winter
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, the season when the Eldrazi took Modern.

archive.what: Colourless Eldrazi decks that used Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple to cast Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher on turn two or three.
archive.why: For a few months the Eldrazi decks dominated Modern. Players called that season Eldrazi Winter.
archive.beat: Kill the creatures early, and do not let them untap with a four-drop on turn two. Cheap removal is everything.
archive.after: Eye of Ugin was banned in Modern in April 2016. Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple are not from this act's sets, so this tribute plays Wastes and Eldrazi Displacer instead.

deck.name: Eldrazi Winter
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: Listen to the sound of defeat.
They are faster than they look. Burn the first one.

after.line: Recorded: Eye of Ugin banned in Modern, April 2016.
